findings.title: MetricAlertDetectorHandler is an uninstantiable abstract class
findings.body: `MetricAlertDetectorHandler` now inherits from `StatefulDetectorHandler[QuerySubscriptionUpdate]` with `pass`, without implementing its abstract methods (`counter_names`, `get_dedupe_value`, `get_group_key_values`, and `build_occurrence_and_event_data`). Because `MetricAlertFire.detector_handler` is set to `MetricAlertDetectorHandler`, accessing `detector.detector_handler` on a `MetricAlertFire` detector calls `MetricAlertDetectorHandler(self)` and raises `TypeError: Can't instantiate abstract class MetricAlertDetectorHandler with abstract methods ...` (and fails mypy's `[type-abstract]` check on `GroupType.detector_handler`).

findings.title: Mismatched group_key in TestEvaluateGroupKeyValue.test_dedupe causes test failure
findings.body: In `TestEvaluateGroupKeyValue.test_dedupe`, `build_mock_occurrence_and_event` is called with `group_key="val1"`, whereas `expected_result` and `handler.evaluate_group_key_value` use `"group_key"`. Because `build_mock_occurrence_and_event` builds the `IssueOccurrence.fingerprint` from `group_key`, the expected occurrence's fingerprint is derived from `"val1"` while the actual occurrence returned by `evaluate_group_key_value` has a fingerprint derived from `"group_key"`, causing the equality assertion at line 546 to fail.
